exposure: fair knowledge of influenza and vaccination
cohort: The study included 338 healthcare workers (predominantly female nurses under 50, with bachelor's degrees and no chronic conditions) from six hospitals in Nakhon Phanom province, Thailand.
finding: Influenza vaccine hesitancy was prevalent among nearly 60% of Thai healthcare workers, with age above 50 years, fair knowledge of influenza and vaccination, and negative influence from other HCWs identified as significant factors.
